description: LANSING, Mich. (Aug. 5, 2026) — Sen. Chedrick Greene (D-Saginaw) applauded today’s announcement that Hemlock Semiconductor will receive $40 million in state funding from the Make It in Michigan Competitiveness Fund. This money will be used to leverage $407 million in private investment and $325 million from the federal CHIPS Incentives Program approved under the Biden administration.
